decision: PASS_GO for the exact attended A90 D1 resident-identity adapter: ordinary resident sessions accept only the exact Phase3-native identity set with V2321 removed, preserved cleanup remains pinned to its existing exact identity, and the unchanged D1 transaction retains no-payload, no-flash, one-dispatch/no-replay, return, cleanup, health, recovery, and A90-only target boundaries
risk_tier: H0 independent review of attended D1 transient no-payload execution capability

inherited_capability_receipt.reuse: The exact minimal-G boot candidate, resident-install-v2 evidence, rollback, recovery, and F1 capability are unchanged; this review covers only their attended-D1 identity consumption.

identity_contract.preserved_cleanup_lane: unchanged exact preserved_prep EXPECTED_VERSION and EXPECTED_BUILD pair

reviewed_semantics.identity_widening: The legacy single ordinary identity is replaced only by three named exact version/build pairs already qualified by the Phase3 staging contract. Set subtraction excludes the canonical V2321 rollback baseline. Arbitrary, mixed, empty, or future identities are not accepted without changing the hash-bound staging closure.
reviewed_semantics.manifest_substitution: SessionSpec candidate version/build are derived from the exact resident-install-v2 manifest, whose candidate path, size, SHA256, boot partition, target, recovery, rootfs, observer, and handoff bindings are reopened. The canonical eleven-record F1 journal repeats the same manifest SHA, candidate identity, exact health, one candidate transfer, zero replay, and RESIDENT_HEALTHY terminal. The D1 manifest cannot substitute another tuple without failing these cross-checks.
reviewed_semantics.live_preflight: Before handoff, the exact bridge is reopened and framed version, status, selftest, and pstore receipts are validated against the same SessionSpec tuple. The final post-return health check repeats the same gate.
reviewed_semantics.device_effect: The changed function performs only identity and health validation. The only D1 effect remains one manifest-bound SWITCHROOT_EXPERIMENT handoff after durable intent, with handoff_dispatch_count_max one and no action replay. It adds no payload, partition write, flash, reboot, candidate transfer, or rollback transfer path.
reviewed_semantics.return_cleanup_health: The unchanged runner requires exact native return evidence, NCM rebinding, exact fixed work-copy cleanup, protected source identity, and final resident health before another ordinal. Observation uncertainty never authorizes redispatch.
reviewed_semantics.target_and_recovery: The resident manifest and D1 manifest retain exact A90 profile, bridge device/realpath, recovery identity/profile, observer key, rootfs identity, and private evidence. No S22+ or other-target input is accepted.
reviewed_semantics.preserved_lane: preserved-install-cleanup-reduced-v1 continues to compare only against the existing preserved_prep exact version/build pair and is not widened by the ordinary Phase3 identity set.

review_findings.finding: Reusing the full Phase3 starting-identity set directly would also admit the V2321 rollback baseline to resident D1.
review_findings.resolution: The implementation subtracts PHASE2_ALLOWED_STARTING_IDENTITIES, and the focused negative test proves exact V2321 rejection while minimal-G passes.

review_trigger.reuse_scope: capability-wide across D1 manifests, sessions, ordinals, and campaigns

final_judgment: PASS_GO qualifies this exact attended A90 D1 identity adapter and named execution closure. It is not target-presence proof, device-health proof, approval, or live authority.
